title: Board snapshot: per-week snapshot, New list and verdict log
description:
Remainder of PPY-4e170a. The shipped snapshot (Papyrus #516, #520) writes items.json, board.json (front and rising) and readers.json. Still missing from the original story: a per-week snapshot alongside the current one, a 'new' list, and a verdict log. Do this only when a site needs it.

```gherkin
Feature: Board snapshot extras
  Scenario: Weekly board
    Given votes across two weeks
    Then a board file exists per week as well as the current one

  Scenario: New list
    Then board.json lists the newest published items regardless of votes
```
